rationale: Top 10: I028 (buy a trades shop with SBA leverage) is the only card whose ceiling is a PE multiple on a durable, sellable cash-flowing asset. I100 (Medicare Advantage renewal book) compounds automatically under CMS-fixed commissions and sells as a book. I107 (fire/life-safety ITM routes), I012 (load-bank testing), I001 (pest control), I013 (medical waste), and I054 (roll-off dumpsters) are code- or habit-mandated recurring routes with consolidator exits and no AI displacement. I106 (cost segregation) and I098 (property-tax protest) ride permanent tax law and annual re-enrollment with $1M ceilings. I067 (home care) is a licensed, recurring, sellable agency in a demographically guaranteed market. Next five: I082 and I036/I037 pay the most in year two but are jobs with no compounding asset and AI-vendor-cycle exposure; I075 (DID reputation service) has the best fit and recurring retainers but sits on outbound calling, a channel AI and carrier policy keep shrinking; I032 (nurse staffing) has a real book but VMS gatekeeping, factoring float, and rate compression cap the durable margin; I015 (estate cleanout) is durable but transactional, so it never compounds into a book. Bottom: expired or negative-EV windows (I079, I099, I007) and capital-fatal plays (I025, I027, I030, I073).
